a.lede: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.
a.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households

b.lede: Multiple family members can share data to help the agent make plans and complete tasks.
b.title: Google announces new experimental "CC" AI agent for families
